propositions: Configuration fields in _config_schema.py may exist without any read sites outside schema/config plumbing, causing the configuration knob to be silently inert.
A deterministic AST-level check must verify that each schema field has at least one attribute-read site (terminal `.field` in Load context) in the codebase.
The check must accept a '# read-via: <pointer>' escape hatch comment for indirect reads (getattr dispatch, client-only knobs) but reject bare markers without a pointer.
The detection logic matches only on the terminal attribute name and fires only when zero references are found, avoiding false positives during refactors that move read sites.
The gate must be wired into CI and pass cleanly at merge with only justified read-via markers applied to legitimately indirect fields.
